### 1. User intent and simulator behaviour
Opening: "I dropped my gown off for alterations last Friday and the shop says they need a deposit before they start — I'd like to pay the deposit now". Target object: ticket AT-5302718 (navy silk gown). Action: pay the pre-work deposit, herself (the script: "When the agent tells you the deposit amount and hands the payment over to you … you complete it yourself … with … your Marlowe & Finch card"). Authorisation: identity via mobile 2145550137 + DOB 1988-03-14. The simulator conveys need, answers when asked, consents passively to "something else has to be put on the ticket … before the deposit can be set", and runs the user tool only when handed over. No figure offered.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now, after the ticket-side writes. Visible grounds:
- `find_alteration_tickets`: `variant_name 'Formal & Evening Wear'`, `status 'dropped_off'`, `rush_service True`, `dropoff_date 2026-11-06`, `needed_by_date 2026-11-18`, `quoted_total 310.0`, `balance_due 310.0`, `purchase_id 52421db0…`.
- pre_work_deposit_payment: "A … ticket in a service class whose deposit percentage is above 0 owes a deposit before the tailor starts the work"; deposit_payment_and_tender_terms: Formal & Evening Wear deposit 50, minimum 50.00. Ticket is `dropped_off` (work not started).
- pre_work_deposit_payment (state-form sentences): "The deposit on a ticket accepted with rush service is worked out only after that ticket carries its rush fee." / "A deposit is not taken until any Finch Circle rush fee waiver the ticket is owed stands on it." `find_alteration_charges` shows only operation and lined_surcharge charges — no rush fee, no waiver. So the deposit cannot be computed now; the two states must first be brought about.

### 3. Business object and correlation
Customer 664650ce…; one ticket 93eaf9e0… (AT-5302718). Charges (all dated 2026-11-06): operations gown_hem_multi_layer 145.00, strap_adjust 28.00, bodice_take_in 75.00; lined surcharges 36.25, 7.00, 18.75. Purchase named on ticket: 52421db0… "Celeste navy silk crepe column gown", regular, regular_price 498.00, completed 2026-10-23, tender mf_card, card_account d8a225bd… Other purchases (boots 0cca07d4…, pumps fa49ac82…, dress fd28a504…) are not on the ticket; they enter only the record-counting factors.

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Rush fee** (rush_fee_amount_calculation + factors):
- Rush-fee operation base = 145+28+75+36.25+7+18.75 = 310.00.
- Rush charge basis (rush_charge_basis_by_work): "Three or more operation charges | per operation: the number of operation charges multiplied by 30.00 USD" — 3 operation charges → 90.00. Led there by: the ticket's operation-charge rows.
- Lead-time multiplier (rush_lead_time_multiplier_schedule): 2026-11-06 → 2026-11-18 = 12 days, "8 to 14 days | 125 percent". Records: ticket drop-off and needed-by dates.
- Lined-work rush premium (lined_work_rush_premium): 3 lined_surcharge charges → "2 or more | 15 percent".
- Cardmember rush discount (cardmember_rush_discount): `find_card_accounts` → 'Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite', active → 10 percent.
- New-purchase rush discount (new_purchase_rush_discount): own record, regular, completed 2026-10-23, 14 days before drop-off → "30 or fewer … 10 percent".
- Occasion rush discount (registry_occasion_rush_discount): `find_registries` → 'Anniversary Registry', active, event_date 2026-11-18 = needed-by date, not a Wedding Registry → 5 percent.
- Adjustment figure 100+15−10−10−5 = 90. Fee = 90.00 × 125/100 × 90/100 = 101.25 (rounded once; exact).
- Fall-back (computation doc alone, no factor): 50 percent (turnaround_and_rush_schedule, Formal & Evening Wear rush fee 50) of 310.00 = **155.00** ≠ 101.25.

**(b) Finch Circle rush fee waiver** (rush_fee_waiver_amount + factors), after the fee stands:
- Class figure "A Finch Circle tier's waived-rush-fee benefit waives this class's rush fee" = yes for Formal & Evening Wear.
- Form (member_rush_waiver_forms): `find_loyalty_memberships` → 'Finch Circle Gold', active; ticket names her own purchase record → "co-pay form".
- Co-pay (member_rush_copay_schedule): Gold, ticket names own record at regular price → 40.00.
- Tenure relief (membership_tenure_rush_relief): enrolled 2014-04-02 → 151 whole months → 10 percent.
- Points relief (points_earning_rush_relief): earn entries dated less than 12 whole months before 2026-11-10: 618 (2026-02-24) + 480 (2026-06-16) + 747 (2026-10-27) = 1845; 900 (2025-10-07) excluded (13 months); the conversion entry is not an earn entry → 5 percent.
- Waiver = (101.25 − 40.00) × (1 + 0.10 + 0.05) = 61.25 × 1.15 = 70.4375 → **70.44**; ≤ 101.25. Booked against the rush fee charge id returned by the booking.
- Fall-back (standard method): whole fee if Gold "carries the waived rush alteration fee benefit", else nil — the tier/benefit mapping lives in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program corpus, not rendered yet (no `docs/loyalty/`): **conditional** (101.25 or 0.00); either way ≠ 70.44.

**(c) Deposit** (pre_work_deposit_amount + factors), after (a) and (b):
- Standing charges = 310.00 + 101.25 − 70.44 = 340.81.
- Form (deposit_form_by_pickup_record): refunds with `refund_trigger 'pickup_not_collected'` dated less than 24 whole months before today: 2025-12-02 counts; 2024-09-03 (26 months) excluded → 1, not "three or more"; standing ≥ 250.00 → **two-part form**: minimum 50.00 + percentage × (340.81 − 250.00 = 90.81).
- Deposit rate (finch_circle_deposit_rate): active Gold → 40.
- Uncollected-order addition: one qualifying refund → +10.
- Garment-tender reduction: named record paid `mf_card` → −10.
- Frequent-shopper reduction: `order_payment` entries dated less than 12 whole months before today: 2026-10-23, 2026-06-14, 2025-11-18 (11 whole months) = 3 → −2 (2024-08-20 excluded). (Excluding the refunded payment still gives 2 → −2.)
- Cardmember deposit reduction: active Store Card Elite → −5.
- Percentage = 40+10−10−2−5 = 33. Deposit = 50.00 + 0.33 × 90.81 = 79.9673 → **79.97**.
- Fall-back (computation doc alone: class 50 percent, percentage form, on the same standing charges): 170.405 → **170.41** ≠ 79.97.
- tender_type: `mf_card` (customer: "my Marlowe & Finch card — the store card"; pre_work_deposit_payment allows any accepted tender except alteration credit).

1. find_customers → verify_customer_identity (agent).
2. find_alteration_tickets / find_alteration_charges / find_loyalty_memberships / find_card_accounts / find_purchases / find_order_events / find_registries / find_loyalty_points_ledger (agent reads).

### 6. Problem tree from the visible materials
Problems: P1 book the rush fee; P2 book the Finch Circle rush fee waiver; P0 (root, customer's write) pay the deposit. Order P1 → P2 → P0.
- Hop P0 ← P1 (**state-derived**): pre_work_deposit_payment "worked out only after that ticket carries its rush fee"; records: `rush_service True`, no rush-fee charge. Searching "rush fee" finds rush_fee_booking: "once it is booked, the ticket carries the rush fee among its charges" — the write that brings the state about.
- Hop P0 ← P2 (**state-derived**): "not taken until any Finch Circle rush fee waiver the ticket is owed stands on it"; whether one is owed: rush_fee_waiver_amount + member_rush_waiver_forms with her Gold record and own purchase → co-pay form, positive. finch_circle_rush_fee_waiver: "Once booked, the Finch Circle rush fee waiver stands on the ticket beside the rush fee it waives" — the write.
- Hop P2 ← P1 (**state-derived**): finch_circle_rush_fee_waiver "A rush fee waiver is booked only after the ticket carries the rush fee it waives."
No hop was handed over by another problem's tool name, a route or an aggregated chain; each hub names only its own tool.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only what she asked" (deposit now): excluded by the two state-form sentences + the records (no rush fee, no waiver). Doing so would give a deposit on 310.00 (factors: 50 + 0.33×60 = 69.80) — a figure the visible rule says is not yet worked out.
- Rush fee without the waiver: excluded by "not taken until any Finch Circle rush fee waiver the ticket is owed stands on it" (would give 103.21).
- Rush basis as 50 % of the base: excluded by rush_charge_basis_by_work (3 operation charges → per-operation row "whatever the base").
- Per-operation deposit form: excluded — only one uncollected-pickup refund lies inside 24 whole months.
- Standard waiver method (whole fee): excluded by member_rush_waiver_forms, "Active Finch Circle Gold or Platinum member | names the member's own … purchase record | co-pay form".
- Co-pay 45.00: excluded — the named record's price type is regular.
- Retired drop-off deposit clause (50 % of quoted total): garment_intake_and_promised_date §4 "For a deposit worked out after drop-off and before the tailor starts the work, this clause is **no longer in force**".
- Tender: alteration credit excluded by pre_work_deposit_payment; she chooses mf_card.
Blind verdict: unique solution derivable: rush fee 101.25 → waiver 70.44 against it → deposit 79.97 by mf_card.

On the policy side, the alteration overwrite restates a loyalty-charter rule that the loyalty corpus does not mark as superseded. This is recorded as a note, not a KB verdict for this task.
